objective:
Fix audit E defects (verification/audit-E-2026-11-13.json). MAJORS: (D1) desktop.py _begin_ask: before injecting Ctrl+C, release ALL held keys of the configured combos including Alt (both sides) via release_held_modifiers(keys=self.ptt.relevant_keys()) exactly like the paste path (NOOP then MARKER key-up; hook ignores MARKER; state machine still sees the key held); remove the 0xA5/0x12 exclusion. (D2) Alt+Space opens the system menu: (a) change DEFAULT_HOTKEYS['ask'] to ['RightAlt+RightCtrl'] and migrate saved settings whose ask combos equal the old default ['RightAlt+Space'] to the new default (any user-customised value is kept); (b) in hotkeys.py add a narrow swallow rule: when a key-down of a NON-modifier key completes a configured combo that contains Alt (any side/generic), the hook returns 1 for that key-down and for its matching key-up (track the vk), so Alt+Space no longer reaches the foreground app; modifiers are never swallowed; keys that do not complete such a combo are never swallowed. Update the hook so it has exactly two return paths (swallow or CallNextHookEx) and update any check that asserted a single return path. Tests: pure machine reports `swallow=True` only for that case; real-key check in scripts/check_hotkey_hook.py: configure LeftAlt+Space as ask, foreground a throwaway Tk window with a menubar (another process), press and hold LeftAlt+Space for 0.5 s, assert the system menu did not open (GetGUIThreadInfo GUI_INSYSMENUMODE or GetMenuBarInfo) and that a bare Space press (no Alt) still reaches the window. (D3) desktop.py _flush_pastes/_paste: merge all deferred pastes for the same target into ONE text (join with '
' in order) → one clipboard write → one Ctrl+V → one scheduled restore; keep the per-target order. Real check in check_wave_d.py: three segments → target receives 'SEG-ONE
SEG-TWO
SEG-THREE' exactly. MINORS: (m1) in ask mode when backend is Whisper (no LLM) set session_error so the final status keeps '沒有可用的 LLM，顯示原始轉錄'; (m2+m3) context.capture_selection: if the clipboard holds non-text formats, skip the capture and return ('', False) without touching the clipboard; if OpenClipboard fails while saving, abort the capture ('', False); desktop shows a one-line status when capture was skipped; (m4) translation TASKS['ask']: add 'The clean-up rules above apply only to understanding the spoken transcript; they do not limit the answer.'; (m5) when context_aware is off, ask sends the selection only (no app/title); (m6) decode_segment: for mode 'ask' when ask_language is 'zh', run the output through engine.converter like zh does; (m7) scripts/check_context_capture.py and scripts/check_wave_d.py save the real clipboard text before and restore it after (empty → empty); (m8) audiofocus: drop handles from _active on restore so the list does not grow; add to the module docstring the note that a force-killed process cannot run atexit and Windows remembers per-app mute (manual will cite it). Re-run every affected check script and refresh their verification JSONs.
acceptance: `.\.build-venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes with new tests for: swallow rule (only completing non-modifier key of an Alt-containing configured combo; modifiers never), settings migration of the old ask default, merged paste text, ask prompt sentence present, capture skipped on non-text clipboard, ask zh output converted.

`scripts\check_hotkey_hook.py` PASS including: LeftAlt+Space ask hold does not open the system menu of a foreground window in another process; bare Space still reaches that window; all earlier scenarios unchanged (use LeftAlt/F23/F24, never Right Alt).

`scripts\check_wave_d.py` ok=true including a new cross-process check: with a held generic Alt combo (LeftAlt+F23 configured as ask), capture_selection obtains the selection from a native EDIT control in another process (state shows no Alt bit on the C key), and the three-segment paste arrives as one correctly ordered text; clipboard restored to its pre-test value.
`scripts\check_context_capture.py` ok=true and the clipboard after the run equals the clipboard before.
smoke_desktop PASS; run_desktop --self-test ok (incl. --mode ask); check_desktop_settings, check_tray_indicator, check_single_instance ok.
notes: Python 3.9, stdlib + ctypes. Typeless.exe runs here and swallows Right Alt: never inject Right Alt. Tk only on the Tk thread. Do not touch iOS, docs, dist. Do not run git.
